paragraphs.sourceText: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a short essay on creation. Your essay should include the importance of creation and measures to be taken to encourage creation. You are required to write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
paragraphs.translationZh: 说明：这部分，你有30分钟的时间写一篇关于创作的短文。你的文章应该包括创造的重要性以及鼓励创造的措施。您需要写至少 150 字但不超过 200 字。

paragraphs.sourceText: Directions: In this section, you will hear three news reports. At the end of each news report, you will hear two or three questions. Both the news report and the questions will be spoken only once. After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A), B), C) and D). Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.

You are required to select out one word for each blank from a lot of choices given in a word bank following the passage. Read the passage through carefully before making your choices. Each choice in the bank is identified by a letter. Please mark the corresponding letter for each item on Answer Sheet 2 with a single line through the centre. You may not use any of the words in the bank more than once.
paragraphs.translationZh: 说明：在本节中，有一段有十个空格。你需要从文章后面的单词库中给出的众多选项中为每个空白选择一个单词。在做出选择之前仔细阅读该段落。银行中的每个选择都由一个字母标识。请在答题卡 2 上的每个项目上用一条穿过中心的单线标记相应的字母。您不得多次使用银行中的任何单词。

paragraphs.sourceText: Small communities, with their distinctive character—where life is stable and intensely human—are disappearing. Some have __26____ from the face of the earth, others are dying slowly, but all have ___27___ changes as they have come into contact with an ___28___ machine civilization. The merging of diverse peoples into a common mass has produced tension among members of the minorities and the majority alike.
paragraphs.translationZh: 具有独特特征（生活稳定且充满人性）的小社区正在消失。有些已经从地球表面消失，有些正在慢慢死亡，但当他们接触到不断扩张的机器文明时，一切都发生了变化。不同民族融合成一个共同的群体，在少数群体和多数群体之间造成了紧张关系。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Old Order Amish, who arrived on American shores in colonial times, have ___29___ in the modern world in distinctive, small communities. They have resisted the homogenization ___30___ more successfully than others. In planting and harvest times one can see their bearded men working the fields with horses and their women hanging out the laundry in neat rows to dry. Many American people have seen Amish families with the men wearing broad-brimmed black hats and the women in long dresses. In railway or bus ___31___.Although the Amish have lived with ___32___ America for over two and a half centuries. They have moderated its influence on their personal lives, their families, communities, and their values.
paragraphs.translationZh: 旧秩序阿米什人在殖民时期抵达美国海岸，在现代世界中以独特的小社区生存下来。他们比其他人更成功地抵制了同质化过程。在播种和收获的时候，人们可以看到留着胡须的男人牵着马在田里干活，女人们把洗好的衣服整齐地晾晒起来。许多美国人都见过阿米什家庭，男人戴着宽边黑帽，女人穿着长裙。在铁路或公共汽车总站。尽管阿米什人已经与工业化的美国一起生活了两个半世纪以上。他们已经减弱了它对他们个人生活、家庭、社区和价值观的影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: The Amish are often ___33___ by other Americans to be relics of the past who live a simple, inflexible life dedicated to inconvenient out-dated customs. They are seen as abandoning both modem ___34___ and the American dream of success and progress, But most people have no quarrel with the Amish for doing things the old-fashioned way. Their conscientious objection was tolerated in wartime. For after all. They are good farmers who ___35___ the virtues of work and thrift.
paragraphs.translationZh: 阿米什人经常被其他美国人视为过去的遗物，他们过着简单、僵化的生活，过着不方便的过时习俗。他们被认为放弃了现代便利设施和成功与进步的美国梦，但大多数人并不反对阿米什人以老式的方式做事。他们出于良心的反对在战时得到了容忍。毕竟。他们是践行劳动和节俭美德的好农民。

paragraphs.sourceText: Directions: In this section, you are going to read a passage with ten statements attached to it. Each statement contains information given in one of the paragraphs. Identify the paragraph from which the information is derived. You may choose a paragraph more than once. Each paragraph is marked with a letter. Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.
paragraphs.translationZh: 说明：在本节中，您将阅读一段附有十个陈述的段落。每条陈述都包含其中一个段落中给出的信息。确定信息来源的段落。您可以多次选择一个段落。每个段落都标有一个字母。通过在答题卡 2 上标记相应的字母来回答问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: Countries Rush for Upper Hand in Antarctica
paragraphs.translationZh: 各国争先恐后地在南极洲占据上风

paragraphs.sourceText: A. On a glacier-filled island with fjords（峡湾）and elephant seals, Russia has built Antarctica’s first Orthodox church on a bill overlooking its research base. Less than an hour away by snowmobile. Chinese laborers have updated the Great Wall Station, a vital part of China’s plan to operate five basses on Antarctica, complete with an indoor badminton court and sleeping quarters for 150 people. Not to be outdone, India’s futuristic new Bharathi base, built on stills（桩子）using 134 interlocking shipping containers, resembles a spaceship. Turkey and Iran have announced plans to build bases, too.
paragraphs.translationZh: 答：在一个充满冰川、峡湾和象海豹的岛屿上，俄罗斯在俯瞰其研究基地的山坡上建造了南极洲第一座东正教教堂。乘坐雪地摩托不到一个小时即可到达。中国工人更新了长城站，这是中国计划在南极洲运营五个基地的重要组成部分，并配有室内羽毛球场和可容纳 150 人的宿舍。印度的未来派新巴拉蒂基地也不甘示弱，它建在桩子上，使用 134 个互锁的集装箱建造，就像一艘宇宙飞船。土耳其和伊朗也宣布了建设基地的计划。

paragraphs.sourceText: B. More than a century has passed since explorers raced to plant their flags at the bottom of the world, and for decades to come this continent is supposed to be protected as a scientific preserve, shielded from intrusions like military activities and mining . But an array of countries are rushing to assert greater influence here, with an eye not just towards the day those protective treaties expire, but also for the strategic and commercial that already exist.
paragraphs.translationZh: B. 自从探险家竞相在世界底部插上旗帜以来，一个多世纪过去了，在未来的几十年里，这片大陆应该作为科学保护区受到保护，免受军事活动和采矿等入侵。但许多国家正急于在这里发挥更大的影响力，不仅着眼于这些保护性条约到期的那一天，还着眼于已经存在的战略和商业条约。

paragraphs.sourceText: C. The newer players are stepping into what they view as a treasure house of resources. Some of the ventures focus on the Antarctic resources that are already up for grabs, like abundant sea life. South Korea, which operates state-of–the-art bases here, is increasing its fishing of krill（磷虾），found in abundance in the Southern Ocean, while Russia recently frustrated efforts to create one of the world’s largest ocean sanctuaries here.
paragraphs.translationZh: C. 新玩家正在步入他们眼中的资源宝库。一些企业专注于已经可供争夺的南极资源，例如丰富的海洋生物。韩国在这里拥有最先进的基地，正在增加对南大洋丰富的磷虾的捕捞，而俄罗斯最近挫败了在这里建立世界上最大的海洋保护区之一的努力。

paragraphs.sourceText: D. Some scientists are examining the potential for harvesting icebergs form Antarctica, which is estimated to have the biggest reserves of fresh water on the planet. Nations are also pressing ahead with space research and satellite projects to expand their global navigation abilities.
paragraphs.translationZh: D. 一些科学家正在研究从南极洲获取冰山的潜力，据估计，南极洲拥有地球上最大的淡水储量。各国还在加紧推进太空研究和卫星项目，以扩大其全球导航能力。

paragraphs.sourceText: E. Building on a Soviet-era foothold, Russia is expanding its monitoring stations for Glonass, its version of the Global Positioning System(GPS). At least three Russian stations are already operating in Antarctica, part of its effort to challenge the dominance of the American GPS, and new stations are planned for sites like the Russian base, in the shadow of the Orthodox Church of the Holy Trinity.
paragraphs.translationZh: E. 在苏联时代的基础上，俄罗斯正在扩大格洛纳斯（Glonass）的监测站，格洛纳斯是其全球定位系统（GPS）的版本。至少三个俄罗斯监测站已经在南极洲运营，这是其挑战美国 GPS 主导地位的努力的一部分，并且计划在俄罗斯基地等地点建立新的监测站，位于圣三一东正教教堂的阴影下。

paragraphs.sourceText: F. Elsewhere in Antarctica, Russian researchers boast of their recent discovery of a freshwater reserve the size of Lake Ontario after drilling through miles of solid ice. “You can see that we’re here to stay,” said Vladimir Cheberdak, 57, chief of the Bellingshausen Station, as he sipped tea under a portrait of Fabian Gottlieb von Bellingshausen, a high-ranking officer in the Imperial Russian Navy who explored the Antarctic coast in 1820.
paragraphs.translationZh: F. 在南极洲的其他地方，俄罗斯研究人员夸耀他们最近在钻探了数英里的固体冰后发现了安大略湖大小的淡水储备。别林斯高晋站站长 57 岁的弗拉基米尔·切贝尔达克 (Vladimir Cheberdak) 在法比安·戈特利布·冯·别林斯高晋 (Fabian Gottlieb von Belingshausen) 的肖像下喝着茶说道：“你可以看到我们会留下来。”费边·戈特利布·冯·别林斯高晋是俄罗斯帝国海军高级军官，曾于 1820 年探索南极海岸。

paragraphs.sourceText: G. Antarctica’s mineral, oil and gas wealth are a longer-term prize. The treaty banning mining here, shielding coveted(令人垂诞的)reserves of iron ore, coal and chromium, comes up for review in 2048. Researchers recently found kimberlite(金伯利岩) deposits hinting at the existence of diamonds. And while assessments vary widely, geologists estimate that Antarctica holds at least 36 billion barrels of oil and natural gas.
paragraphs.translationZh: G. 南极洲的矿产、石油和天然气财富是一项长期奖励。禁止在这里采矿、保护令人垂涎的铁矿石、煤炭和铬储量的条约将于 2048 年接受审查。研究人员最近发现了金伯利岩矿床，暗示存在钻石。尽管评估差异很大，但地质学家估计南极洲至少蕴藏着 360 亿桶石油和天然气。

paragraphs.sourceText: H. Beyond the Antarctic treaties, huge obstacles persist to tapping these resources, like drifting icebergs that could jeopardize offshore platforms. Then there is Antarctic’s remoteness, with some mineral deposits found in windswept locations on a continent that is larger the Europe and where winter temperatures hover around minus 55 degrees Celsius.
paragraphs.translationZh: H. 除了南极条约之外，开发这些资源仍然存在巨大障碍，例如可能危及海上平台的漂浮冰山。南极洲地处偏远，在比欧洲还大的大陆上多风的地方发现了一些矿藏，那里的冬季气温徘徊在-55摄氏度左右。

paragraphs.sourceText: I. But advances in technology might make Antarctica a lot more accessible three decades from now. And even before then, scholars warn, the demand for resources in an energy-hungry world could raise pressure to renegotiate Antarctica’s treaties, possibly allowing more commercial endeavours here well before the prohibitions against them expire. The research stations on King George lsland offer a glimpse into the long game on this ice-blanketed continent as nations assert themselves, eroding the sway long held by countries like the United States, Britain. Australia and New Zealand.
paragraphs.translationZh: I. 但技术的进步可能会让三十年后前往南极洲变得更加容易。学者们警告说，甚至在此之前，能源匮乏的世界对资源的需求可能会增加重新谈判南极洲条约的压力，从而可能在针对南极洲的禁令到期之前允许更多的商业活动。乔治王岛上的研究站让我们得以一睹这片冰雪覆盖的大陆上的长期博弈，各国都在维护自己的主权，侵蚀着美国、英国等国家长期占据的影响力。澳大利亚和新西兰。

paragraphs.sourceText: J. Being stationed in Antarctica involves adapting to life on the planet’s driest, windiest and coldest continent, yet each nation manages to make itself at home. Bearded Russian priests offer regular services at the Orthodox church for the 16 or so Russian speakers who spend the winter at the base, largely polar scientists in fields like glaciology and meteorology. Their number climbs to about 40 in the warmer summer months. China has arguably the fastest growing operations in Antarctica. It opened its fourth station last year and is pressing ahead with plans to build a fifth. It is building its second ice-breaking ship and setting up research drilling operations on an ice dome 13,422 feet above sea level that is one the planet’s coldest places. Chinese officials say the expansion in Antarctica prioritises scientific research. But they also acknowledge that concerns about “resource security” influence their moves.
paragraphs.translationZh: J. 驻扎在南极洲需要适应地球上最干燥、风最大和最寒冷的大陆上的生活，但每个国家都设法让自己像在家里一样。留着胡须的俄罗斯牧师在东正教教堂为在基地过冬的大约 16 名讲俄语的人提供定期服务，其中大部分是冰川学和气象学等领域的极地科学家。在温暖的夏季，它们的数量会攀升至约 40 只。中国可以说是南极洲业务增长最快的国家。去年，该公司开设了第四个车站，目前正在推进建设第五个车站的计划。该公司正在建造第二艘破冰船，并在海拔 13,422 英尺的冰穹上开展研究钻探作业，该冰穹是地球上最冷的地方之一。中国官员表示，南极洲的扩张优先考虑科学研究。但他们也承认，对“资源安全”的担忧影响了他们的行动。

paragraphs.sourceText: K. China’s newly renovated Great Wall Station on King George lsland makes the Russian and Chilean bases here seem outdated. ”We do weather monitoring here and other research.” Ning Xu, 53, the chief of the Chinese base, said over tea during a fierce blizzard(暴风雪) in late November. The large base he leads resembles a snowed-in college campus on holiday break, with the capacity to sleep more than 10 times the 13 people who were staying on through the Antarctic winter. Yong Yu, a Chinese microbiologist, showed off the spacious building, with empty desks under an illustrated timeline detailing the rapid growth of China’s Antarctic operations since the 1980s “We now feel equipped to grow,” he said.
paragraphs.translationZh: K.中国在乔治王岛上新装修的长城站让这里的俄罗斯和智利基地显得过时。 “我们在这里进行天气监测和其他研究。” 11月下旬，暴风雪袭来，53岁的中国基地负责人宁旭在喝茶时说道。他领导的庞大基地就像假期里被大雪覆盖的大学校园，其睡眠能力是在南极冬天留下来的 13 个人的 10 倍多。中国微生物学家于勇展示了这座宽敞的建筑，里面空荡荡的办公桌，下面附有插图时间表，详细介绍了自 20 世纪 80 年代以来中国南极行动的快速发展，“我们现在感觉有能力发展，”他说。

paragraphs.sourceText: L. As some countries expand operations in Antarctica, the United States maintains three year-round stations on the continent with more than 1,000 people during the southern hemisphere’s summer, including those at the Amundsen Scott station, built in 1956 at an elevation of 9,301 feet on a plateau at the South Pole. But US researchers quietly complain about budget restraints and having far fewer icebreakers the Russia, limiting the reach of the United States in Antarctica.
paragraphs.translationZh: L. 随着一些国家扩大在南极洲的业务，美国在南半球夏季期间在该大陆维持了三个全年观测站，共有 1,000 多名人员，其中包括阿蒙森斯科特站，该站建于 1956 年，位于南极高原上，海拔 9,301 英尺。但美国研究人员悄悄抱怨预算限制以及破冰船数量远少于俄罗斯，限制了美国在南极洲的活动范围。

paragraphs.sourceText: M. Scholars warn that Antarctica’s political drift could blur the distinction between military and civilian activities long before the continent’s treaties come up for renegotiation, especially in parts of Antarctica that are ideal for intercepting(拦截) signals from satellites or retasking satellite systems, potentially enhancing global electronic intelligence operations.
paragraphs.translationZh: M.学者警告说，早在南极洲条约重新谈判之前，南极洲的政治倾向就可能模糊军事和民用活动之间的区别，特别是在南极洲部分地区，这些地区非常适合拦截来自卫星的信号或重新分配卫星系统的任务，从而有可能增强全球电子情报行动。

paragraphs.sourceText: N. Some countries have had a hard time here, Brazil opened a research station in 1984, but it was largely destroyed by a fire that killed two members of the navy in 2012, the same year that a diesel-laden Brazilian barge sank near the base. As if that were not enough. a Brazilian C-130 Hercules military transport plane has remained stranded near the runway of Chile’s air base here since it crash-landed in 2014.
paragraphs.translationZh: N. 一些国家在这里度过了一段艰难的时光，巴西于 1984 年开设了一个研究站，但该站大部分被 2012 年一场大火摧毁，这场大火导致两名海军成员丧生，同年，一艘满载柴油的巴西驳船在基地附近沉没。好像这还不够。一架巴西C-130大力士军用运输机自2014年坠毁以来一直滞留在智利空军基地跑道附近。

paragraphs.sourceText: O. However, Brazil’s stretch of misfortune has created opportunities for China, with a Chinese company winning the $100 million contract in 2015 to rebuild the Brazilian station.
paragraphs.translationZh: 然而，巴西的厄运却为中国创造了机遇，2015年，一家中国公司赢得了价值1亿美元的巴西车站重建合同。

paragraphs.sourceText: P) Amid all the changes, Antarctica maintains its allure. South Korea opened its second Antarctic research base in 2014, describing it as a way to test robots developed by Korean researchers for use in extreme conditions. With Russia’s help, Belarus is preparing to build this first Antarctic base. Colombia said this year that it planned to join other South American nations with bases in Antarctica. Q) “The old days of the Antarctic being dominated by the interests and wishes of white men from European. Australasian and North American states are over.” Said Klaus Dodds, a politics scholar at the University of London who specialises in Antarctica. “The reality is that Antarctica is geopolitically contested.”
paragraphs.translationZh: P) 尽管发生了所有的变化，南极洲仍然保持着它的吸引力。韩国于 2014 年开设了第二个南极研究基地，将其描述为测试韩国研究人员开发的在极端条件下使用的机器人的一种方式。在俄罗斯的帮助下，白俄罗斯正准备建设第一个南极基地。哥伦比亚今年表示，计划与其他南美国家一起在南极洲设立基地。问）“南极洲的旧时代由欧洲白人的利益和愿望主导。澳大利亚和北美国家已经结束了。”专门研究南极洲的伦敦大学政治学者克劳斯·多兹说道。 “现实是南极洲存在地缘政治争议。”

paragraphs.sourceText: 36. According to Chinese officials, their activities in Antarctica lay greater emphasis on scientific research.
paragraphs.translationZh: 36. 据中国官员称，他们在南极洲的活动更加注重科学研究。

paragraphs.sourceText: 37. Efforts to create one of the world’s largest ocean sanctuaries failed because of Russia’s obstruction.
paragraphs.translationZh: 37. 由于俄罗斯的阻挠，创建世界上最大的海洋保护区之一的努力失败了。

paragraphs.sourceText: 38. With several monitoring stations operating in Antarctica, Russia is trying hard to counter America’s dominance in the field of worldwide navigational facilities.
paragraphs.translationZh: 38. 俄罗斯在南极洲设有多个监测站，正在努力对抗美国在全球导航设施领域的主导地位。

paragraphs.sourceText: 39. According to geologists’ estimates. Antarctica has enormous reserves of oil and natural gas.
paragraphs.translationZh: 39. 根据地质学家的估计。南极洲拥有巨大的石油和天然气储量。

paragraphs.sourceText: 40. It is estimated that Antarctica boasts of the richest reserves of fresh water on earth.
paragraphs.translationZh: 40. 据估计，南极洲拥有地球上最丰富的淡水储量。

paragraphs.sourceText: 41. The demand for energy resources may compel renegotiation of Antarctica’s treaties before their expiration.
paragraphs.translationZh: 41. 对能源的需求可能迫使南极洲条约在到期前重新谈判。

paragraphs.sourceText: 42. Many countries are racing against each other to increase their business and strategic influence on Antarctica.
paragraphs.translationZh: 42. 许多国家正在竞相增加对南极洲的商业和战略影响力。

paragraphs.sourceText: 43. Antarctica’s harsh natural conditions constitute huge obstacles to the exploitation of its resources.
paragraphs.translationZh: 43. 南极洲恶劣的自然条件对其资源的开发构成巨大障碍。

paragraphs.sourceText: 44. With competition from many countries, Antarctica is no longer dominated by the traditional white nations.
paragraphs.translationZh: 44. 由于来自许多国家的竞争，南极洲不再由传统的白人国家主导。

paragraphs.sourceText: 45. American scientists complain about lack of sufficient money and equipment for their expansion in Antarctica.
paragraphs.translationZh: 45. 美国科学家抱怨缺乏足够的资金和设备来进行南极洲的扩张。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 46 至 50 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Any veteran nicotine addict will testify that fancy packaging plays no role in the decision to keep smoking. So, it is argued, stripping cartons of their branding will trigger no mass movement to quit.
paragraphs.translationZh: 任何一个资深的尼古丁成瘾者都会证明，精美的包装对继续吸烟的决定没有任何影响。因此，有人认为，剥离纸盒上的品牌不会引发大规模戒烟运动。

paragraphs.sourceText: But that isn’t why the government—under pressure from cancer charities, health workers and the Labour party— has agreed to legislate for standardized packaging. The theory is that smoking should be stripped of any appeal to discourage new generations from starting in the first place. Plain packaging would be another step in the reclassification of cigarettes from inviting consumer products to narcotics（麻醉剂）.
paragraphs.translationZh: 但这并不是政府在癌症慈善机构、卫生工作者和工党的压力下同意为标准化包装立法的原因。该理论认为，应该剥夺吸烟的任何吸引力，以阻止新一代人开始吸烟。无装饰包装将是卷烟从消费品重新分类为麻醉剂的又一步。

paragraphs.sourceText: Naturally, the tobacco industry is violently opposed. No business likes to admit that it sells addictive poison as a lifestyle choice. That is why government has historically intervened, banning advertising, imposing health warnings and punitive (惩罚性的) duties. This approach has led over time to a fall in smoking with numbers having roughly halved since the 1970s. Evidence from Australia suggests plain packaging pushes society further along that road. Since tobacco as one of the biggest causes of premature death in the UK, a measure that tames the habit even by a fraction is worth trying.
paragraphs.translationZh: 自然遭到烟草业的强烈反对。没有哪个企业愿意承认自己出售令人上瘾的毒药作为一种生活方式的选择。这就是为什么政府历来进行干预，禁止广告，施加健康警告和惩罚性义务。随着时间的推移，这种方法导致吸烟率下降，自 20 世纪 70 年代以来吸烟人数大约减少了一半。来自澳大利亚的证据表明，平装包装推动社会在这条道路上走得更远。由于烟草是英国过早死亡的最大原因之一，因此即使只是一小部分控制这种习惯的措施也值得尝试。

paragraphs.sourceText: So why has it taken so long? The Department of Health declared its intention to consider the move in November 2010 and consulted through 2012. But the plan was suspended in July 2013. It did not escape notice that a lobbying firm set up by Lynton Crosby, David Cameron’s election campaign director, had previously acted for Philip Morris International. (The prime minister denied there was a connection between his news adviser’s outside interests and the change in legislative programme.) In November 2013, after an unnecessary round of additional consultation, health minister Jane Ellison said the government was minded to proceed after all. Now we are told Members of Parliament (MPs) will have a free voice before parliament is dissolved in March.
paragraphs.translationZh: 那么为什么花了这么长时间呢？卫生部于 2010 年 11 月宣布打算考虑这一举措，并在 2012 年进行了咨询。但该计划于 2013 年 7 月被暂停。人们注意到，大卫·卡梅伦的竞选总监林顿·克罗斯比 (Lynton Crosby) 成立的一家游说公司此前曾为菲利普莫里斯国际公司代理。 （总理否认他的新闻顾问的外部利益与立法计划的改变之间存在联系。）2013 年 11 月，经过一轮不必要的额外磋商后，卫生部长简·埃里森表示，政府最终还是打算继续推进。现在我们被告知，在三月份议会解散之前，议会议员将拥有自由发言权。

paragraphs.sourceText: Parliament has in fact already authorised the government to tame the tobacco trade. MPs voted overwhelmingly in favour of Labour amendments to the children and families bill last February that included the power to regulate for plain packaging. With sufficient will in Downing Street this would have been done already. But strength of will is the missing ingredient where Mr. Cameron and public health are concerned. His attitude to state intervention has looked confused ever since his bizarre 2006 lament (叹息) that chocolate oranges placed seductively at supermarket check-outs fueled obesity.
paragraphs.translationZh: 事实上，议会已经授权政府控制烟草贸易。去年二月，议员们以压倒性多数投票支持工党对儿童和家庭法案的修正案，其中包括监管无装饰包装的权力。如果唐宁街有足够的意愿，这件事早就完成了。但就卡梅伦先生和公共卫生而言，意志力是缺失的要素。自从 2006 年他对超市收银台上诱人的巧克力橙子加剧肥胖发出奇怪的叹息以来，他对国家干预的态度就显得很困惑。

paragraphs.sourceText: The government has moved reluctantly into a sensible public health policy, but with such obvious over-cautiousness that any political credit due belongs to the opposition. Without sustained external pressure it seems certain Mr. Cameron would still be hooked on the interests of big tobacco companies.
paragraphs.translationZh: 政府不情愿地采取了明智的公共卫生政策，但明显过于谨慎，任何应得的政治功劳都属于反对派。如果没有持续的外部压力，卡梅伦先生似乎仍会沉迷于大型烟草公司的利益。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 51 to 55 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 问题 51 至 55 基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: What a waste of money!In return for an averageof£44,000 of debt,students get an average of only 14 hours of lecture and tutorial time a week in Britain. Annual fees have risen from£1,000 to $9,000 in the last decade. But contact time at university has barely risen at all. And graduating doesn’t even provide any guarantee of a decent job:sixin ten graduates today are in non-graduate jobs.
paragraphs.translationZh: 真是浪费钱！在英国，学生平均每周只能获得 14 个小时的讲座和辅导时间，但平均还欠了 44,000 英镑的债务。过去十年，年费从 1,000 英镑上涨到 9,000 美元。但大学里的接触时间几乎没有增加。毕业甚至不能保证找到一份体面的工作：今天有六十名毕业生从事非毕业生工作。

paragraphs.sourceText: No wonder it has become fashionable to denounce many universities as little more that elaboratecom-tricks(骗术). There’s a lotfor students to complain about the repayment threshold for paying back loans will be frozen for five years, meaning that lower-paid graduals have to start repaying their loans, and maintenance grants have been replaced by loans meaning that students from poorer backgrounds face higher debt than those with wealthier parents.
paragraphs.translationZh: 难怪现在流行谴责许多大学只不过是精心设计的骗术。有很多学生抱怨偿还贷款的还款门槛将被冻结五年，这意味着收入较低的学生必须开始偿还贷款，而生活补助金已被贷款取代，这意味着来自贫困家庭的学生比那些父母富裕的学生面临更高的债务。

paragraphs.sourceText: Yet it still pays to go to university. If going to university doesn’t work out, students pay very little—if any—of their tuition fees back, you only start repaying when you are earning £21, 000 a year. Almost half of graduates—those who go on to earn less—will have a portion of their debt written off. It’s not just the lectures and tutorials that are important. Education is the sum of what students teach each other in between lectures and seminars. Students do not merely benefit while at university, studies show they go on to be healthier and happier than non-graduates, and also far more likely to vote.
paragraphs.translationZh: 然而，上大学仍然是值得的。如果上大学不成功，学生只需偿还很少的学费（如果有的话），只有在年收入达到 21, 000 英镑时才开始偿还。几乎一半的毕业生（那些继续收入减少的人）的部分债务将被注销。重要的不仅仅是讲座和教程。教育是学生在讲座和研讨会之间互相教授的内容的总和。学生不仅在大学期间受益，研究表明他们比非毕业生更健康、更快乐，而且更有可能投票。

paragraphs.sourceText: Whatever your talents, it is extraordinarily difficult to get a leading job in most fields without having been to university. Recruiters circle elite universities like vulturous(兀鹰). Many top firms will not even look at applications from those who lack a 2.1, i.e., an upper-second class degree, from an elite university. Students at university also meet those likely to be in leading jobs in the future, forming contacts for life. This might not be right, but school-leavers who fail to acknowledge as much risk making the wrong decision about going to university.
paragraphs.translationZh: 无论你的才能如何，如果没有上过大学，想要在大多数领域找到领先的工作都是非常困难的。招聘人员像兀鹰一样围绕着精英大学。许多顶尖公司甚至不会考虑那些缺乏精英大学 2.1（即二等以上学位）的申请。大学里的学生还会遇到那些未来可能担任领导职务的人，形成终生的联系。这可能是不对的，但那些未能承认这一点的毕业生可能会做出关于上大学的错误决定。

paragraphs.sourceText: Perhaps the reason why so many universities offer their students so little is they know studying at a top university remains a brilliant investment even if you don’t learn anything .Studying at university will only become less attractive if employers shift their focus away from where someone went to university—and there is no sign of that happening anytime soon. School-leavers may moan, but they have little choice but to embrace university and the student debt that comes with it.
paragraphs.translationZh: 也许这么多大学为学生提供的教育如此之少的原因是，他们知道，即使你没有学到任何东西，在顶尖大学学习仍然是一项明智的投资。如果雇主将注意力从某人就读的大学转移，那么在大学学习只会变得不那么有吸引力——而且没有迹象表明这种情况会很快发生。高中毕业生可能会抱怨，但他们别无选择，只能接受大学和随之而来的学生债务。
